scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d db && docker compose exec -T db sh -c 'until mysqladmin ping -h localhost --silent; do sleep 1; done'
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d db && docker compose exec -T db sh -c 'until mysqladmin ping -h localhost --silent; do sleep 1; done'
scripts.dev:local: npm run db:up && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:generate && next dev
scripts.postbuild: rm -rf .next/standalone/.next/static .next/standalone/public && mkdir -p .next/standalone/.next && cp -R .next/static .next/standalone/.next/static && if [ -d public ]; then cp -R public .next/standalone/public; fi
scripts.deploy:prepare: npm run db:deploy && npm run build
